pageDescription: Who hears about incidents, reports and SLO burn, and how.

stakeholders.intro: Stakeholders receive what they subscribe to. Keigan sends only to people listed here, matches the affected services and the incident priority, and writes in each person's language (English or Japanese, other languages receive English).
stakeholders.emptyDescription: Add the people, Teams channels or distribution lists that should hear about incidents in this application.
stakeholders.serviceHint: Leave all unchecked to notify this person about every service.
stakeholders.searchHelper: Searches the company directory (or local users while running locally). You can also type an email address below.
stakeholders.minimumPriorityHelper: Incidents below this priority are not sent. P1 is the most severe.
stakeholders.deleteDescription: {{name}} will no longer receive notifications from Keigan for this application.
stakeholders.readOnly: You can view stakeholders, but only application admins can change them.

channels.teams_incident_chatHelp: Added to the private group chat Keigan creates for each qualifying incident, where it posts findings and answers questions.
channels.teams_channelHelp: Keigan posts updates in the chosen Teams channel.

types.incident_detectedHelp: An email as soon as an incident is detected; also decides who is invited to the incident chat.
types.preliminary_reportHelp: Keigan's first findings, usually within minutes.
types.progress_updateHelp: Approved updates and the resolution notice.
types.postmortemHelp: The postmortem once it is finalised and sent.
types.intelligence_reportHelp: Weekly digest and proactive predictive alerts.
types.slo_burn_alertHelp: When an error budget is burning faster than planned.

room.title: Teams incident room
room.empty: No Teams chat exists for this incident yet. Keigan creates one when the incident priority meets a chat subscriber's threshold.
room.simulatedBanner: Simulated Teams: messages stay inside Keigan. In live mode this room is a real Microsoft Teams group chat.
room.liveBanner: This mirrors the Microsoft Teams group chat. Write in Teams to talk to the team and Keigan.
room.noFacts: Nothing captured yet. Keigan adds what responders do, such as restarts and rollbacks, to the incident timeline.
room.composerPlaceholder: Write a message. Start with "Keigan, ..." to ask Keigan.
room.hintAsk: Keigan, what changed in the last hour?
room.loadError: The Teams chat could not be loaded.
